blocks.content: The Jammu and Kashmir Reorganisation Act, 2019 reconstituted the state of Jammu and Kashmir into two Union Territories: Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh.

items: The Act came into force on October 31, 2019 (National Unity Day).
UT of Ladakh is directly administered by a Lieutenant Governor without a Legislative Assembly.
Article 370 remains in the text of the Indian Constitution but was rendered inoperative by Presidential Orders.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The Jammu & Kashmir Reorganisation Act, 2019 bifurcated the state into two Union Territories: Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh.
The UT of Jammu & Kashmir retains a Legislative Assembly, whereas the UT of Ladakh does not have a legislature.
Article 370 and Article 35A were rendered inoperative, extending the entire Constitution of India to both Union Territories.
The reorganisation took effect on October 31, 2019, commemorating the birth anniversary of Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel.
